subject: Tomatoes along the shared fence?
text: Hi! Would you mind if I planted tomatoes along the east side of our shared garden plot? They'd get more sun there. Ann

subject: Could you look over my cover letter?
text: I'm applying for the library assistant job and attached my cover letter. Would you read it and tell me if it sounds too stiff? Sam

subject: That lemon cake recipe
text: The lemon cake you brought to the potluck was wonderful. Would you share the recipe? I promise not to pass it off as mine.

subject: Is the blue bike still for sale?
text: Hello, I saw your listing for the blue commuter bike. Is it still available for sale, and would you take a lower offer?

subject: Next book club pick
text: We need to choose the next book. The two finalists are a mystery set on a lighthouse and a memoir about beekeeping. Which do you prefer?

subject: Question on the budget spreadsheet
text: In the shared budget sheet, row 14 lists printer supplies twice. Did you mean to add them under both teams, or should I remove one?

subject: Photos from the ridge hike
text: Here are the photos from the ridge hike. The one of the fog over the valley came out great. Want me to send the full-size files?

subject: Borrowing your ladder
text: Hi, could I borrow your extension ladder to clear the gutters? I'll bring it back the same day.

subject: Lunch on Thursday?
text: Are you free for lunch on Thursday around 12:30? There's a new noodle place near the station I'd like to try.

subject: Planning the school fundraiser
text: Could we meet next Tuesday evening to plan the school fundraiser? Let me know what time works and I'll book the library room.

subject: Which paint color did you pick?
text: Your new front door looks great. Which paint color did you go with? I'm trying to choose one for our porch.

subject: Plumber recommendation
text: Our kitchen sink keeps backing up. Do you have a plumber you trust? You mentioned someone good a while back.

subject: Invoice for the roof repair
text: Attached is the invoice for the roof repair at your house. Please pass it to whoever handles your household accounts.

subject: Registration details for your team
text: Registration is open for the regional librarians conference. Feel free to share these details with your colleagues.

subject: Documents needed from your co-signer
text: To finish the rental application we need proof of income from your co-signer. Please forward this request to them.

subject: Emergency contact form for the soccer club
text: Each player needs an emergency contact form signed by both guardians. Please share this with the other parent.

subject: Volunteer sign-up sheet
text: We are short of volunteers for the food drive. Please pass the sign-up sheet along to anyone in your building who might help.

subject: Opening for a junior illustrator
text: We are hiring a junior illustrator. If you know someone who would be a good fit, please forward them this posting.

subject: Claim paperwork for the co-owner
text: Claim 88231 for the hail damage needs a signature from the other owner of the vehicle. Please send this form to them.

subject: Venue details for the wedding party
text: Here are directions and parking details for the lakehouse venue. Please share them with the rest of the wedding party.

subject: Your passport renewal window opens in March
text: Your passport can be renewed starting in March. Renewing earlier is not possible; we will accept your form from then on.

subject: Spring play tickets go on sale soon
text: Members get first pick of seats for the spring play once sales open in two weeks. We'll send the link when it is live.

subject: Car registration renewal coming up
text: Your car registration expires at the end of next month. Renewal opens 30 days before the expiry date.

subject: Tax documents will be ready after the 15th
text: Your annual tax documents will be ready to download after the 15th. There is nothing to do until then.

subject: Your watch repair
text: Your watch is being repaired. It will be ready to collect from the 20th onward; bring this email as your claim slip.

subject: Seed order window opens soon
text: The heirloom seed order window opens in a few weeks. Your saved list is waiting; orders placed before then can't be accepted.

subject: Your library hold is in transit
text: The book you placed on hold is in transit to your branch. It isn't ready yet; we'll let you know once it arrives.

subject: Re: quote for the fence repair
text: Thanks for showing us the damaged fence. We'll put together a quote and send it over in a few days.

subject: Re: refund request 4471
text: We have received your returned kettle. Refunds can take up to ten business days to process.

subject: Re: reference letter
text: Of course I'm happy to write a reference letter for you. I'll send it to the admissions office by the end of the month.

subject: Re: lost luggage claim 5512
text: Your bag has been located and will be delivered to your home address. A courier will contact you to arrange delivery.

subject: Re: deposit return
text: I inspected the apartment and everything looks fine. I will return your deposit once the final utility bill clears.

subject: Re: your application
text: Thank you for applying for the pastry assistant position. We'll be in touch after we finish reviewing applications.

subject: Re: sofa delivery
text: Your sofa has left our warehouse. Our delivery team will reach out to agree on a delivery slot.

subject: Re: the camera you lent me
text: Thanks again for lending me your camera for the trip. I'll get it back to you as soon as I've cleaned the lens.

subject: Your electricity bill is ready
text: Your electricity bill for 84.20 is ready. Pay by the 28th at https://billing.power.example/pay to avoid a late fee.

subject: Sign your lease renewal

subject: Complete your patient intake form

subject: Overdue fine on your account

text: Dues for the new season are 40 and are due by the 1st. Pay at https://chessclub.example/dues.

subject: Please approve the shared budget

subject: Return your juror questionnaire

subject: Last chance: 40% off garden gnomes

subject: The Bird Watcher, issue 41
text: In this issue: a rare heron sighting at the reservoir, tips for winter feeders, and readers' best photos.

subject: Neighborhood association news
text: The association repainted the playground fence, the tree-planting drive raised enough for twelve trees, and dues stay the same.

subject: Tech Press digest: three stories
text: Three stories this issue: a new open hardware keyboard, a look at solar-powered routers, and a guide to backing up photos.

subject: Community library newsletter
text: New arrivals in the mystery section, the knitting circle has moved to the upstairs room, and the book sale raised funds for laptops.

subject: Recipe roundup from Example Kitchen
text: This roundup features a one-pot lentil stew, crispy roasted chickpeas, and a no-knead bread for beginners.

subject: Running club newsletter
text: Congratulations to members who finished the river half marathon. New route maps are posted and the club shirts are in.

subject: Alumni bulletin

text: Version 3.2 adds dark mode, fixes the export bug on large files, and speeds up search.
